analysis.subject: physics
analysis.pageCoverage: Page covers kinetic theory assumptions of small widely spaced molecules in random motion, defines density as mass per volume, pressure as momentum transfer per area, temperature as mean kinetic energy, and static versus dynamic versus total pressure.

overview.headline: How random molecular motion creates gas pressure and temperature

keyPoints.point: Molecules are very small relative to the distance between them and are in constant random motion.
keyPoints.quote: The model, called the kinetic theory of gases, assumes that the molecules are very small relative to the distance between molecules.

keyPoints.point: Gas molecules collide with the walls of a container and impart momentum to the walls producing a measurable force.
keyPoints.quote: As the gas molecules collide with the walls of a container, the molecules impart momentum to the walls, producing a force that can be measured.

keyPoints.point: Temperature is a measure of the mean kinetic energy of gas motion and rises with greater motion.
keyPoints.quote: The temperature of a gas is a measure of the mean kinetic energy of the gas.

keyPoints.point: Static pressure from random motion and dynamic pressure from ordered motion combine to form total pressure.
keyPoints.quote: And Bernoulli’s equation tells us that the sum of the static and dynamic pressure is the total pressure which we can also measure.

keyTerms.gloss: model that assumes gas molecules are small and widely spaced
keyTerms.quote: The model, called the kinetic theory of gases, assumes that the molecules are very small relative to the distance between molecules.

keyTerms.gloss: mass of molecules divided by volume they occupy
keyTerms.quote: The density of a gas is simply the sum of the mass of the molecules divided by the volume which the gas occupies.

keyTerms.gloss: measure of linear momentum transferred to walls per area
keyTerms.quote: The pressure of a gas is a measure of the linear momentum of the molecules.

keyTerms.gloss: measure of mean kinetic energy of gas molecules in motion
keyTerms.quote: The temperature of a gas is a measure of the mean kinetic energy of the gas.

keyTerms.gloss: pressure produced by random component of molecular motion
keyTerms.quote: We measure the pressure produced by the random component as the static pressure.

keyTerms.gloss: pressure produced by ordered motion of the fluid
keyTerms.quote: The pressure produced by the ordered motion is called dynamic pressure.
